name: AMR Volume Rendering via VTK Tetrahedralization
aliases: Complementing adaptive wavelet grid to a correspondent AMR grid
definition: Rendering AMR grid data by converting cubic cells into unstructured tetrahedral meshes (VTK_TETRA) and using VTK-based renderers.
summary: AMR Volume Rendering via VTK Tetrahedralization renders adaptive mesh data by converting cubic cells into tetrahedra for VTK compatibility, differing from wavelet summation by requiring high memory.
